skill1: ■ Activates when Full Burst ends. Affects self.
skill2: ■ Activates when Full Burst ends. Affects all allies.

caveats: ⚑ Tilted Scale granularity: the kit grants 29 stacks × 0.75% per last bullet, capped at 100 stacks (=75% crit rate). The engine adds ONE stack per trigger, so the buff is authored as 18.75%/stack × maxStacks 4 = the correct 75% cap reached after 4 last-bullet triggers (kit truth: cap reached on the 4th, partial, grant). Per-application credit is 18.75% vs the true 21.75%, so the early ramp is slightly under-credited and the cap is exact.

⚑ 'Removes Tilted Scale' on Full-Burst-end is NOT modeled — the effect schema has no buff-removal primitive (removeOnReload is reload-keyed only). The sim therefore HOLDS crit rate at the 75% cap for the rest of the fight instead of resetting it each Full Burst; this OVER-CREDITS average crit rate. Real behaviour is a sawtooth: reset at FB end, rebuilt over ~4 magazines (~15-20 s with the S2 ammo cut live).

⚑ Skill-1 rider trigger is crit-COUNT gated ('pellets land a critical hit 4 times'); the engine has no crit-count trigger, so it is approximated as hitCount:5 (4 crits ÷ an assumed ~0.8 time-average crit rate). Unmeasured.

⚑ Burst swap: the 10 pellets are MERGED into one 925% shot (10 × 92.5%). Split-vs-merge is kit-silent and matters for per-pellet core/landing/gauge. If the engine applies the base hitsPerShot (2) to swap shots this double-counts — halve to 462.5 if a swap-shot popup ladder shows two hits per pull.
⚑ Burst swap cadence 2 pulls/s = base SMG effective ~20/s with Attack Speed ▼90%. The base rate is a datamine-derived value and the swap's own cadence is kit-silent; unmeasured.
⚑ 'Removes Fulfillment of Righteousness' at FB end is not modeled (no removal primitive); the 10 s duration bounds the over-credit to at most the remainder of an in-flight window.

The S2 Max Ammunition ▼51.13% is modeled as a real weapon-state effect on ALL allies (it cuts every ally's magazine, raising reload frequency and, for k herself, last-bullet frequency — which feeds both her own stacking and the S2 re-application). It is a damage-relevant line, not a defensive one.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Model of k (SMG/Electric/Attacker/Burst III, ammo 120, hitsPerShot 2): S1 is a last-bullet crit-rate stacker (Tilted Scale, 0.75%/stack × 29 per trigger, cap 100 stacks = +75% crit) plus a crit-count-gated 23.9%-of-final-ATK rider on the boss; S2 rides the SAME last-bullet trigger ('when gaining Tilted Scale') to give ALL allies a 10 s Attack Damage ▲10.62% paired with a Max Ammunition ▼51.13% weapon-state cut; the burst is a 10 s self weapon swap (92.5%/pellet × 10 pellets, Attack Speed ▼90%) with self ATK ▲63.36%-of-own-ATK and Attack Damage ▲21.12%. Two Full-Burst-end removal lines are unrepresentable in the current schema and are recorded in `unmodeled` — the Tilted Scale one is the largest known over-credit in this baseline.

flags.reasoning: Kit grants 29 stacks × 0.75% per last bullet with a 100-stack cap (75%). The engine adds one stack per trigger application, so the per-application magnitude must be re-expressed. 18.75 × 4 hits the cap EXACTLY after 4 last bullets (kit truth: the cap lands on the 4th, partial, grant of 13 stacks); 21.75 × 4 would overshoot to 87%, 21.75 × 3 would undershoot to 65.25%. Cap fidelity chosen over per-application fidelity because the unit sits at cap for most of a magazine cycle.
flags.recipe: Read k's crit-rate stat in-fight (or infer from the crit share of her SMG popups) at ~5 s, ~15 s and ~30 s after a Full Burst ends; fit the ramp shape and the plateau. Plateau should read base crit + 75%.

flags.field: skill1 — FB-end reset of Tilted Scale (unmodeled)
flags.estimate: over-credit of roughly 10-25% of the crit-rate contribution over a 180 s fight
flags.reasoning: The schema has no buff-removal effect, so the sim holds the cap permanently. Real behaviour is a sawtooth: full reset at every FB end, rebuilt at 29 stacks per last bullet. With the S2 Max-Ammo ▼51.13% live, k's magazine is ~59 rounds; at ~20 pulls/s × 2 hits she empties in ~1.5-3 s plus a ~2.15 s reload, so 4 last bullets ≈ 15-20 s — a large fraction of the inter-FB gap is spent at or near cap, which is why the error is a partial rather than a total over-credit. NOT patched with an invented haircut value.
flags.recipe: Either add a buff-removal primitive keyed to fullBurstEnd (engine work), or measure the crit share of k's popups in the 5 s window immediately after a Full Burst ends vs the 5 s before the next one, and compare against the sim's flat-cap assumption.

flags.reasoning: No crit-gated trigger exists in TriggerDef. Converting: 4 crits ÷ p(crit). p is itself driven by this unit's own Tilted Scale stack (base sheet crit ~15% + up to 75% → ~0.9 at cap, lower during the ramp); a ~0.8 time-average gives 4/0.8 = 5 hits. hitCount counts ROUNDS, and k's hitsPerShot is 2, so count 5 ≈ 2.5 trigger pulls. This is an ESTIMATE, not a kit value.
flags.recipe: Count 23.9%-of-ATK rider popups over a full recorded fight and divide k's total landed hit count by that number; that ratio IS the correct hitCount threshold. Cross-check against the crit share of her normal popups in the same footage.

flags.reasoning: weaponSwap has no pellet-count field. Split-vs-merge is kit-silent (ALWAYS-⚑ #5). Merge is chosen because the alternative (92.5% per shot) makes the burst weapon a damage DOWNGRADE vs her base SMG (92.5% × 2/s = 185%/s vs 9.1% × 2 hits × 20/s = 364%/s), which is not a plausible reading of a Burst III weapon change. Residual risk: if the engine applies the base hitsPerShot (2) to swap shots, this double-counts and the correct value is 462.5.
flags.recipe: Read one burst window frame-by-frame: count popups per trigger pull (10 small vs 1 large) and their values relative to a known ATK. Popup count also settles the hitsPerShot question — divide the observed per-pull total by 92.5% of final ATK to get the true effective pellet count.

flags.reasoning: Attack Speed ▼90% applied to the base SMG's effective cadence. The base cadence itself comes from a datamine field flagged unreliable, and the swap weapon's own cadence is never stated; a swap can also load a different shot spec entirely. Weapon-swap shot economy is ALWAYS-⚑ (#3) — estimated optimistically (no wind-up, no reload assumed inside the 10 s window).
flags.recipe: Count trigger pulls (or popup groups) across a full 10 s burst window in footage — 20 pulls confirms 2/s. Also check whether the swap weapon reloads within the window; if it does, the shot economy needs a maxAmmo on the weaponSwap.

flags.estimate: left unset — swap keeps the base SMG class

flags.recipe: If burst-window popups show sub-shot fractional landing (fewer than 10 pellet hits at range, or falloff by band), re-author as weapon:'SG' with damagePct 92.5 per pellet plus the appropriate pellet-count representation, and re-verify the core rate of swap shots against the SMG baseline.
